# Kempes Scooter Rental Trogir

> Kempes rents scooters to visitors in Trogir, Seget Donji, Vranjica and Čiovo, Croatia. The business is based in Seget Donji and offers free delivery and pickup within its service area for rentals of at least one day. It does not deliver to Split Airport or outside the listed service area.

## Booking and location

- Call or WhatsApp: [+385 98 780 021](https://rent-trogir.com/contact.html)
- Email: [tt.motori@gmail.com](mailto:tt.motori@gmail.com)
- Address: Hrvatskih žrtava 152, Seget Donji, Croatia
- Opening hours: Daily, 08:00–20:00
- Booking is arranged by phone or WhatsApp; contact Kempes to confirm availability and the rental price.

## Scooter rentals

- [50cc scooters](https://rent-trogir.com/scooter50cc.html): €29 for 12 hours, €33 for a full day, or €29 per day for a weekly rental.
- [125cc scooters](https://rent-trogir.com/scooter125cc.html): from €44 for 12 hours or €48 for a full day. Weekly rates may vary.
- [250cc and 300cc scooters](https://rent-trogir.com/scooter250cc.html): from €47 for 12 hours, €53 for a full day, or €50 per day for a weekly rental.
- Helmets and basic insurance are included. Check the relevant scooter page and confirm current terms when booking.

## Delivery area

Free delivery and pickup are available for rentals of at least one day in Seget Donji, Vranjica, Trogir and Čiovo, including Okrug Gornji and Okrug Donji. No delivery is offered to Split Airport or locations outside these areas.

## Languages

The website is primarily in English. The business can assist in Croatian, German and Italian; Polish support is limited. French-language support has not been confirmed.
